items.title: We design superyachts for billionaires. Their wishlists are changing, from hyperbaric chambers to WFY setups.
items.summary: Vripack's Marnix Hoekstra and Bart Bouwhuis design luxury superyachts for billionaires. Popular asks include high-end offices and gyms.
items.titleZh: 我们为亿万富翁设计超级游艇。他们的愿望清单正在发生变化，从高压舱到WFY装置。
items.summaryZh: Vripack的Marnix Hoekstra和Bart Bouwhuis为亿万富翁设计豪华超级游艇。受欢迎的问题包括高端办公室和健身房。

items.title: DOGE self-deletes on July 4th. The grand experiment fell apart long before that.
items.summary: Tech mogul Elon Musk’s band of Silicon Valley disruptors have already moved on as DOGE’s charter is scheduled to expire.
items.titleZh: DOGE将于7月4日自动删除。这个伟大的实验早在那之前就失败了。
items.summaryZh: 随着DOGE的章程即将到期，科技巨头埃隆·马斯克的硅谷破坏者乐队已经离开了。

items.title: I joined the CIA in my 20s, Google in my 30s, and became an entrepreneur in my 40s. My mantra? 'Sure, I'll try it.'
items.summary: Candice Bryant spent nearly 16 years at the CIA before joining Google. She shares why she left Big Tech and the philosophy that's guided her career.
items.titleZh: 我20多岁加入中情局，30多岁加入谷歌，40多岁成为一名企业家。我的咒语？“当然，我试试。”
items.summaryZh: 坎迪斯·布莱恩特在加入谷歌之前，在中央情报局工作了近16年。她分享了自己离开Big Tech的原因以及指导她职业生涯的哲学。

items.title: Macron and Modi turn on personal charm offensives as France and India race to secure AI investment
items.summary: Macron and Modi are courting tech CEOs as France and India seek AI data center investment and cloud infrastructure.
items.titleZh: 马克龙和莫迪开启个人魅力攻势，法国和印度竞相争取人工智能投资
items.summaryZh: 随着法国和印度寻求人工智能数据中心投资和云基础设施，马克龙和莫迪正在讨好科技公司的首席执行官。
